name: eldric

source.prompt: the same man as the concept portrait, Eldric the travelling merchant, about 50 years old: same face, dark chestnut-brown hair swept back with a few gray strands, short slightly unkempt beard; knee-length dark moss-green wool merchant coat with weathered brown leather panels, wide folded collar and small brass fasteners; burgundy tunic, cream undershirt, dark brown leather waistcoat; belt with small coin pouches, a ring of old iron keys and a small leather ledger; leather satchel at the hip; small brass open-circle pendant on a cord; on his back the same small wooden merchant carrying frame as his younger self, with a folded cloth bundle and a rolled blanket tied to it (no modern backpack, no glowing bottles); worn leather boots; full body; dark fantasy pixel art

pivot.note: foot contact point in frame pixels

sheet_layout: rows = directions in 'directions' order, columns = frames, no spacing

portrait.source: POST /v2/generate-image-v2 (192 px, guided by the sprite; protagonist portrait as style image)

notes: Hair: grays in the head area recoloured to chestnut on every frame (tools/pixellab/recolor_hair.py) so Eldric reads ~50, matching his portrait.
